question: What is the Electric Power Generation Capability of Chandrayaan -2's Rover-Pragyan?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**50W.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• It weighs a **total of 27 kg** and has an electric power generation capacity of **50 W**.
 
• According to ISRO, The **Pragyan Rover** is capable of conducting **in-situ payload experiments.**
 
• Chandrayaan-2's Rover was **a 6-wheeled robotic vehicle** named as Pragyan, which translates to 'wisdom' in Sanskrit.
 
• **The failure of Chandrayaan-2, India's second mission to the Moon, to make a soft landing on the lunar surface** had led to much disappointment. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87067fc455efcb1dae3515b4468c85a616858685a338fe07c19b08441fee4e23.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Chandrayaan-1, India's first mission to Moon, was begin successfully on **October 22, 2008, from SDSC SHAR, Sriharikota.**** **
 
• The spacecraft operated for less than two years: **312 days** as against two years.
 
• But, **the Chandrayaan-1 was successful in achieving at least 95 percent of its objectives**.
